atlas-context.description: Use Atlas-first retrieval without reading full files
atlas-context.template: Use ace-stream first, then ace-packet if needed, then npm run index:clusters:query, then atlas.search, then rg exact section, then read only a 40-80 line window. Return sourceRefs, chunkIds, commands, clusterPath, cache keys, and a short answer. Do not read full .md, .txt, .json files.

ace-packet.description: Build compact ACE packet for the current query
ace-packet.template: Build an ACE packet for the user's query. Prefer cached summaries, sourceRefs, chunkIds, searchGroups, and commands. Do not read full files.

ace-stream.description: Stream a compact ACE packet and validate Redis cache packet injection
ace-stream.template: Build a compact ACE packet for the user's query, stream through the cache lane, verify Redis hot-path packet injection, and report packet hash, cache keys, and any cache miss. Do not read full files.

atlas-cluster.description: Query the Atlas manifold cluster map before reading files
atlas-cluster.template: Run npm run index:clusters:query for the user's query, identify the top cluster path, then use rg inside only that cluster. Return clusterId, clusterPath, sourceRefs, chunkIds, and commands.

workspace-ready.description: Validate Windows workspace, sidecars, semantic indexing, and feature readiness
workspace-ready.template: First run `npm --prefix .. run opencode:bootstrap` to refresh ACE context, recommendations, Bitfrost verification, and MCP health. Then validate config, discover scripts, check sidecars, run codebase indexing, and write memory/agent-runs/latest-workspace-ready.json. Use ACE hits and recommendations first; do not jump to model-only answers.

workspace-bootstrap.description: Refresh ACE context, local health, and report artifacts from the main repo
workspace-bootstrap.template: Run `npm --prefix .. run agent:hello && npm --prefix .. run opencode:bootstrap` from the repo root to refresh ACE context, TODO summary, MCP health, semantic index, recommendations, startup briefing, and Bitfrost verification. Do not modify files. Prefer ACE hits and recommendations before any model-only response.

graph-export-recover.description: Recover graph export artifacts without task delegation
graph-export-recover.template: Run deterministic graph recovery. Do not delegate. Do not use the task tool. Apply OpenCode patches, patch graph export fallback roots, run graph exports, run DuckDB smoke, and write memory/agent-runs/latest-recovery.json.

recover:graph.description: Run ACE graph export recovery without task delegation
recover:graph.template: Run deterministic graph recovery. Do not delegate. Do not use the task tool. Apply OpenCode patches, patch graph export fallback roots, run graph exports, run DuckDB smoke, and write memory/agent-runs/latest-recovery.json.

redis8-eval-smoke.description: Smoke the isolated Redis 8 eval lane without touching the Redis 7 app stack
redis8-eval-smoke.template: Run npm run smoke:redis8-eval and report Redis 8, Agent Memory API :8010, and MCP :9010 health only. Do not modify the main request path or the Redis 7 app stack.

gemma4-offload.description: Repo-audit-only MCP for evidence-grounded summaries and classifications.

engram-embed.description: stdio-only embeddings MCP; no chat or generic generation.

ldr-research.description: Local Deep Research: async multi-engine research via Gemma4 + SearXNG + Wikipedia. Tools: ldr.start_research, ldr.poll_status, ldr.search_history, ldr.quick_summary

atlas-context.description: Atlas-first retrieval agent using ACE packets and strict context-budget rules.
atlas-context.prompt: Repo evidence first. Check .opencode/recommendations/recommendations.json, .opencode/recommendations/recommendations.md, .opencode/recommendations/recommendation-events.jsonl, .opencode/tasks/task-state.json, .opencode/tasks/task-state.md, .opencode/tasks/task-events.jsonl, docs/graph/recommendations.md, docs/reports/temporal-task-registry-report.md, and the relevant Parent Atlas or ACE report before answering. Use report or command output only. Findings are historical, recommendations are append-only inbox items, tasks are persistent, and task-history packets record transitions. If evidence is missing, say what report or command is needed. Use Gemma4 only after evidence is gathered, and only for repo-audit summaries. Never use it for generic chat, model selection, or tutorials.

antigravity.description: General-purpose agent: bash, read, grep, MCP tools. Use for tool-calling tests and operational tasks.
antigravity.prompt: You have access to bash, read, grep, glob, and MCP tools. RULE: When the user asks you to run a command, you MUST call the bash tool immediately. Do NOT write text explanations first. Do NOT describe what you will do. Call the tool with the exact command. First action = tool call, not text.

trace-audit.description: Read-only TRACE audit agent with compact context tools.
trace-audit.prompt: Before reading any .md, .json, .sql, or schema file, call: 1. atlas.compact_context, 2. context.build_kv_packet, 3. ace.compact_search. Do not read whole Markdown files. Use grep/list first. If raw file access is required, read only the smallest line window needed using file.read_window. Prefer compressed cards, source refs, and stablePrefixHash. Use TRACE MCP prompt-cache flow first: call context.build_kv_packet or atlas.compact_context before broad retrieval, keep the stable system prefix unchanged, and prefer cached compressed cards over raw file expansion. Follow .github/instructions/opencode-context-prefetch.instructions.md. Use atlas.compact_context first, then atlas.query or trace.kag_search only as needed. If no TRACE tool is visible, stop with TRACE_MCP_NOT_AVAILABLE. Do not edit files or mutate Postgres, Redis, Qdrant, Neo4j, or the filesystem.

audit-hermes.description: Hermes 64K direct fallback lane via Ollama; no ACE enrichment
audit-hermes.prompt: Before reading any .md, .json, .sql, or schema file, call: 1. atlas.compact_context, 2. context.build_kv_packet, 3. ace.compact_search. Do not read whole Markdown files. hermes-ace.description: Hermes-ACE local agent using ACE context, MCP tools, and repo-audit-only local Gemma4.
hermes-ace.prompt: Repo evidence first. Check .opencode/recommendations/recommendations.json, .opencode/recommendations/recommendations.md, .opencode/recommendations/recommendation-events.jsonl, .opencode/tasks/task-state.json, .opencode/tasks/task-state.md, .opencode/tasks/task-events.jsonl, docs/graph/recommendations.md, docs/reports/temporal-task-registry-report.md, docs/reports/engram-adapter-decision-report.md, and the matching Parent Atlas report before answering. Before reading any .md, .json, .sql, or schema file, call: 1. atlas.compact_context, 2. context.build_kv_packet, 3. ace.compact_search. Do not read whole Markdown files. Use grep/list first. If raw file access is required, read only the smallest line window needed using file.read_window. Prefer compressed cards, source refs, and stablePrefixHash. Use MCP tools in this order: trace.kag_search or trace.atlas_query, then turbovec-sidecar, then engram-embed, then langextract, then ldr.search_history / ldr.quick_summary, then ldr.start_research / ldr.poll_status. Use Gemma4 only after repo evidence is gathered, and only for repo-audit summaries or runtime diagnostics. Never use it for generic chat, model selection, or tutorials. Prefer repo_report_answer over gemma4_chat, which is deprecated.

audit.description: Read-only SvelteKit 2 / Svelte 5 / Drizzle / Zod auditor (no MCP, local files only)
audit.prompt: You are a read-only codebase auditor. Focus on SvelteKit 2, Svelte 5 runes, Bits UI, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL schemas, Zod validations, SSR boundaries, API routes, and deep audit safety. Do not edit files.
